idea: How to maintain a home water system
title: Essential Routine Care for Your Home Water System
description: Routine maintenance prevents costly emergency plumbing repairs and protects your water quality. Start by flushing your water heater once a year to clear mineral sediment from the bottom of the tank, which improves heating efficiency and extends tank life. Next, locate and exercise your main water shut-off valve twice a year to ensure it operates smoothly during an emergency. Finally, monitor your household water pressure with a simple threaded pressure gauge. Maintaining pressure between 40 and 70 PSI prevents stress on pipe joints and extends fixture life. If you notice persistent pressure issues or stubborn leaks, consult a licensed plumbing professional.
